dataSource: Sample Crop Health Guidance Rules (Demo Mock)
disclaimer: Simulated guidance. Not a verified diagnosis. Consult a local agriculture officer (Krishi Vigyan Kendra - KVK) for definitive testing.

symptoms.label: Yellow stripe powder / pustules on leaves
symptoms.hindiLabel: पत्तियों पर पीली धारियां या पीला पाउडर
symptoms.possibleIssue: Suspected Yellow Rust (Stripe Rust) / पीला रतुआ
symptoms.generalGuidance: Yellow rust thrives in cool, humid conditions. Avoid excessive urea application. Ensure field drainage.
culturalSteps: Monitor unaffected areas of the field immediately.
Avoid walking through infected patches into healthy areas when wet to prevent spore dispersal.
Consult your nearest KVK officer before applying any fungicide (such as Propiconazole 25% EC).

symptoms.label: Premature drying of shoots & root damage
symptoms.hindiLabel: पौधे का सूखना और जड़ों में दीमक/कीट का असर
symptoms.possibleIssue: Suspected Termite Damage or Root Rot / दीमक या जड़ सड़न
symptoms.generalGuidance: Common in light or dry soils with un-decomposed farmyard manure.
culturalSteps: Ensure only well-decomposed organic manure is used.
Maintain adequate soil moisture during seedling stage.
Consider treating irrigation water with recommended neem formulations or biocontrol agents.

symptoms.label: General yellowing of lower leaves without spots
symptoms.hindiLabel: निचली पत्तियों का सामान्य पीलापन (बिना धब्बों के)
symptoms.possibleIssue: Likely Nitrogen Deficiency / नाइट्रोजन की कमी
symptoms.generalGuidance: Nitrogen is mobile in the plant, causing older bottom leaves to yellow first.
culturalSteps: Apply split dose of nitrogenous fertilizer or foliar spray of 2% Urea in the evening.
Check soil moisture before fertilizer top-dressing.

symptoms.label: Concentric brown rings / target spots on lower leaves
symptoms.hindiLabel: निचली पत्तियों पर गोल भूरे छल्ले जैसे धब्बे
symptoms.generalGuidance: Early blight is a fungal infection favored by alternating wet and dry periods.
culturalSteps: Prune and discard infected lower leaves (do not compost them).
Avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation; use drip irrigation to keep foliage dry.
Mulch soil around plants to prevent soil-splash onto lower foliage.

symptoms.label: Leaves curling upward, stunted growth, tiny white flies
symptoms.hindiLabel: पत्तियां ऊपर की ओर मुड़ना, बौनापन और सफेद मक्खी
symptoms.possibleIssue: Suspected Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (पर्ण कुंचन रोग)
symptoms.generalGuidance: Transmitted by whitefly (Bemisia tabaci). Infected plants cannot be cured; focus on preventing spread.
culturalSteps: Install yellow sticky traps (15-20 traps per acre) to monitor and trap whiteflies.
Remove severely stunted plants to prevent further transmission.
Spray neem-based biopesticide (Azadirachtin 10,000 ppm @ 2ml/L) to manage vector population.

symptoms.label: Dark water-soaked rot at fruit blossom end
symptoms.hindiLabel: फल के निचले हिस्से में काला धंसा हुआ सड़न
symptoms.generalGuidance: Not an infectious disease, but a physiological disorder caused by irregular watering and poor calcium uptake.
culturalSteps: Maintain consistent, regular soil moisture; avoid extreme drying out between waterings.
Apply foliar spray of Calcium Nitrate (0.5%) during fruit setting.

symptoms.label: Bright yellow mosaic patches on leaves
symptoms.hindiLabel: पत्तियों पर चमकीले पीले और हरे रंग के चकत्ते
symptoms.possibleIssue: Suspected Yellow Mosaic Virus (YMV) / पीला मोज़ेक
symptoms.generalGuidance: Viral condition spread by whitefly vectors during warm, humid spells.
culturalSteps: Rogue out and bury early infected plants.
Erect yellow sticky traps across the plot.
Consult KVK for vector control advisories.

symptoms.label: Stem girdling / dark lesions near soil level
symptoms.hindiLabel: तने पर जमीन के पास भूरी धारियां या सड़न
symptoms.possibleIssue: Suspected Girdle Beetle or Stem Rot / तना छेदक या सड़न
symptoms.generalGuidance: Damages sap flow, causing upper foliage to wilt.
culturalSteps: Ensure field is not waterlogged.
Deep summer plowing reduces pupal survival in subsequent seasons.

symptoms.label: Purplish-brown sunken lesions on leaves
symptoms.hindiLabel: पत्तियों पर बैंगनी-भूरे रंग के लंबे धब्बे
symptoms.generalGuidance: Fungal infection thriving in humid conditions over 25°C.
culturalSteps: Avoid excessive overhead irrigation.
Maintain adequate spacing between onion seedlings to allow air circulation.
Consult KVK experts for standard advisory.

symptoms.label: Silvery white streaks on leaves, tiny insects in folds
symptoms.hindiLabel: पत्तियों पर चांदी जैसी सफेद धारियां (थ्रिप्स कीट)
symptoms.generalGuidance: Thrips scrape leaf surface and suck sap, leading to dry curled tips.
culturalSteps: Install blue sticky traps which specifically attract thrips.
Spray neem oil (5 ml per liter of water) with a natural spreader.

symptoms.label: Spindle-shaped lesions with gray centers and brown borders
symptoms.hindiLabel: पत्तियों पर नाव या धुरी के आकार के भूरे धब्बे
symptoms.generalGuidance: A major fungal disease favored by high humidity and excessive nitrogen.
culturalSteps: Reduce nitrogen fertilizer doses; apply potash to strengthen plant walls.
Maintain proper water level in the field.
Seek verification from local agriculture department.

symptoms.label: Rosetted flowers, bore holes in bolls, pink larvae inside
symptoms.hindiLabel: गुलाब के फूल जैसे खिले हुए फूल और गूलर में गुलाबी सुंडी
symptoms.generalGuidance: Major commercial pest in cotton bolls impacting lint quality.
culturalSteps: Install pheromone traps (5-8 per acre) for early monitoring.
Promptly collect and destroy dropped shed flowers and bolls.
